scope: Minimal repair of the failed Recovery3 monitor so native host diagnostics can execute

causalSeparation.result: full-build passed; native startup failed before Marionette
causalSeparation.known: cause-host-exited observed the open helper status before adopting a browser
causalSeparation.unknown: Actual browser spontaneous exit, exit code/signal and original timeout cause are UNKNOWN_NOT_RECORDED

causalSeparation.result: full-build interrupted by monitor-unavailable at 803.59s; native NOT_RUN
causalSeparation.known: The already reviewed harness startup patch applied and its derived hash matched; configure passed; ps state was unavailable in three bounded samples.
causalSeparation.causality: This monitoring defect is a separate blocker to reaching the native diagnostics; no claim that it caused the earlier host failure.

monitorRepair.source: Darwin task-level libproc counters with exact-size232, PID/UID/PGID/birth and coherent live-task validation; ps is only a PGID/PID inventory.
monitorRepair.cpu: Mach absolute counters converted using the actual successful positive mach_timebase_info numerator/denominator.
monitorRepair.state: Derived libproc runnable-thread summary, labeled separately from ps sleep state.
monitorRepair.missing: Unknown remains incomplete; measured zero is accepted only in a coherent live record. GONE requires BSD zombie, independently observed ESRCH, or replacement of an expected precise generation.
monitorRepair.bounds: At most three measurements 0.25 seconds apart; unavailable live memory fails; recovered observation gaps reset stall accounting. Resource limits are checked even if counters fail.
monitorRepair.nativeProcesses: The same probe replaces RSS-missing-to-zero and BSD/path-missing-to-gone behavior for owned native processes.

nativeDiagnosticAddition.changedBehavior: Capture startup diagnostics and reject a known unexpected host exit during cleanup, following the pinned harness rule; launch arguments/environment/signature/authentication conditions unchanged.
beforeCleanup: Launcher status versus observed exact browser liveness/exit code/signal
Configured switch allowlist and actual argv observation status
Native probe environment booleans, with LaunchServices application environment explicitly unverified before Marionette
Separate stdout/stderr/launcher head+tail32KiB windows, fixed markers and at most eight numeric OSStatus codes
nativeDiagnosticAddition.afterCleanup: Requested cleanup signal and observed termination are separate; a known nonzero exit other than the actually requested cleanup signal fails and preserves the first failure.
nativeDiagnosticAddition.firstFailure: Fixed timeout classifications and numeric OS errno preserve the first failure through diagnostic and cleanup errors.

gates.earlyMac: Require positive self RSS, actual timebase and coherent ABI plus a complete native counter sample during owned process churn before Runtime checkout/build.
